descriptor: Private mood journal with a monthly mosaic

voice.summary: Writes like a kind friend asking how you are at the end of the day, with no hurry and no diagnosis. Sentences are short, lowercase-friendly in tone and never clinical.
dos: Name feelings in everyday words like low or rough
Remind people their entries stay on their own device
donts: Never score or judge a mood

taglines: A small light at day's end
Your mood, one tile at a time
Write it down. Let it glow
boilerplate: Dayglow is a private daily mood journal that turns five drawn faces and a few lines of writing into a colourful monthly mosaic, stored only on your device.

microcopy.error: That did not save. Your words are still here, try again.
microcopy.empty: No entry for this day. Pick a face to begin.

logo.note: A little spark of light echoes the name and the idea that even a rough day leaves a glow.
